name: ux-gates

extension.name: UX gates
extension.description: Installs the ux-ui-agent-skills kit under tools/ and adds its objective gates to make verify: no literal colour, size or duration outside the design tokens, and real-render contrast, focus, target-size, responsive and axe checks over screen previews where a browser is present. Needs a browser app.
